messages:
sam: Follow-up from the authz postmortem: permission-drift + missed rotations caused the outage. Need an owner-driven playbook so this doesn't repeat.

lina: Agreed. Proposal: (A) harden rotation job (idempotent + canary + metrics), (B) recurring audit + dashboard, (C) runbook + manual checklist + emergency rotation shortcut.

omar: I'll take (A) rotation hardening (TASK-712). Deliverables: idempotent runner, canary flag, metrics (rot_success, rot_fail), CI e2e that injects config drift. ETA 2026-04-05.

kevin: I'll own (B) audits/alerts (TASK-713). Plan: Splunk tile for tokens with ttl>60d, query for legacy secret paths, and a pager rule for sustained rotation failures. Draft by 2026-03-30.

sam: I'll do (C) runbook + emergency shortcut (TASK-714). Runbook should include step-by-step manual rotation, verification checks, and a one-click emergency run that targets a canary namespace first. Draft by 2026-03-28.

incident-bot: Created board items: https://boards.redwood.ai/board/rot-playbook  (TASK-712, TASK-713, TASK-714).

omar: Quick notes from manual remediation tonight: svc-payments rotated OK, svc-billing OK, svc-metrics failed due to legacy path mapping. Logs: ```rot svc-payments ok
rot svc-billing ok
rot svc-metrics failed: /secret/old/path not found```

kevin: svc-metrics flagged — adding infra ticket to remap secret paths and marking it a blocker for TASK-712. I'll include this in the audit scope.

sam: Can we also add a recurring check that alerts when any service has tokens with ttl>60d OR manual-exempt flag present? Make the rule part of TASK-713.

kevin: Working Splunk draft: ```index=auth_logs | where ttl_days>60 OR secret_path LIKE "/secret/old%" | stats values(secret_path) by service, token_id``` Will add a dashboard and pager.

omar: I'll instrument the rotation job with counters and a health metric rotation_missed_namespaces. CI e2e will simulate a regex change and expect rotation_missed_namespaces==0 for non-exempt namespaces. PR planned: 4551.

sam: Ownership summary: TASK-712 -> omar -> 2026-04-05; TASK-713 -> kevin -> draft 2026-03-30; TASK-714 -> sam -> draft 2026-03-28. Sync scheduled Thu 2026-04-01 09:00 PT (15m) to confirm progress.

security-eng: FYI I'll run a quick inventory today to find other services using legacy secret paths and long-lived tokens; will attach CSV to the board. Add any hits as blockers to TASK-712.

kevin: Added temporary oncall watch for next week once the pager rule is merged.

omar: Manual remediation completed after infra remap. Final logs: ```rot svc-payments ok
rot svc-billing ok
rot svc-metrics ok```

sam: Great work. I'll update the incident doc with tasks and target closing the follow-up by 2026-04-12 if checks pass. Thanks everyone.
